title: Mili Rehai Tu Abid Yeh Kaam Kar Key Chaley
body:
Ye Ahlay Shaam Se Bolay Agar Na Ho Zehmat
Diya Jalaa Diya Kar Na Agar Milay Fursat
Behen Ke Waaste Ye Ihtemaam Kar Ke Chalay
Sab Aansoo Qabrey Sakina Ke Naam Kar Ke Chalay
<<DIVIDER>>
Dua Jo Karti Thi Ro Ro Ke Wo Bhi Din Aaye
Wo Jis Ke Dil Main Ye Armaan Tha Watan Jaaye
Usse Hawala E Zindan E Shaam Kar Ke Chalay
Sab Aansoo Qabrey Sakina Ke Naam Kar Ke Chalay
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Humara Mara To Kaha Hussain Hussain
Aza Ka Farsh Bicha To Kaha Hussain Hussain
Ye Intezaam Bhi Chauthay Imam Kar Ke Chalay
Sab Aansoo Qabrey Sakina Ke Naam Kar Ke Chalay
<<DIVIDER>>
Zafar Sadaa Yehi Aati Thi Ay Meray Baba
Sabhi Watan Gaye Main Qaid Main Rahi Tanha
Lehed Pe Ahle Haram Jab Salaam Kar Ke Chalay
Sab Aansoo Qabrey Sakina Ke Naam Kar Ke Chalay
